name: Amit Gupta
player_statement:
A complete player, Amit Gupta has made a big mark in cricket. With 671 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 72, with an average of 12.21 and a quick strike rate of 99.76. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 234 sixes and 422 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 1,606.5 overs, taking 791 wickets at an economy rate of 10.51. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
